subject.title: fix: preserve Feishu post line breaks

question: Should maintainers require exact-head live Feishu proof for this broader branch before choosing it over https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99394?
rationale: The patch is source-correct and extensively tested, but only the sibling candidate currently demonstrates the provider and client behavior in a real environment; automation cannot establish which branch should own the canonical fix without equivalent proof.

options.title: Require exact-head proof

options.title: Prefer the proven sibling

options.title: Run maintainer-owned proof
